quote:
When the wind of war blows, even the mightiest bamboo bends before the storm of conscience.

A single spark of hope can ignite a flame that outshines the darkest of bombs.

Justice, like the river, flows steadily; it does not heed the loudest cries of those who seek its favor.

In the face of relentless chaos, the quiet heart finds threads to weave peace from shattered shields.

Even when thunder shakes the heavens, the seed of truth remains buried, waiting to bloom in calm soil.

The fiercest fire of war consumes itself, leaving only the memory of its scorched breeze.

To judge a warrior’s soul, observe not the blade but the wind that carries it.
quote_preview: When the wind of war blows, even the mightiest bamboo bends before the storm of conscience.
